disclaimer.design: AI assists with research design and hypotheses. Have a specialist review scientific validity and feasibility.

features.title: Platform Features
features.subtitle: 7 AI agents + browser-local architecture, covering the full research lifecycle
features.agentsDesc: From topic discovery to peer review rebuttal, each stage has a dedicated AI assistant. All data is stored in your browser — no server database needed.
features.localFirstDesc: All data stored in IndexedDB via Dexie.js. Your research data is completely private and never leaves your device.
features.vectorSearchDesc: Transformers.js runs the all-MiniLM-L6-v2 model in your browser, generating 384-dim embeddings for semantic literature search.
features.auditTrailDesc: Hash-chained audit ledger records all agent operations, ensuring transparency and verifiability for academic integrity.
features.streamingAIDesc: Real-time output from DeepSeek models via Server-Sent Events, with support for interruption and regeneration.
features.i18nThemeDesc: Bilingual Chinese/English interface with IBM tech blue dark theme for immersive research.
features.exportImportDesc: Complete JSON backup and restore with Base64-encoded attachments. Incremental backup support keeps your research data safe.
features.techStackDesc: Next.js 14 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui + Dexie.js + Transformers.js + DeepSeek API

pricing.subtitle: Transparent, predictable pricing. Pay for what you use, no hidden fees.

pricing.tokenNote: AI calls are billed by actual token usage. DeepSeek API pricing: $0.14/1M tokens (input) and $0.28/1M tokens (output). Call counts above are estimates based on average usage.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: All research data is stored in your browser's IndexedDB. iScholar runs no server-side database — your data is completely private.
faq.a2: Yes. Pro and Team plans are monthly subscriptions that can be cancelled anytime. You'll still have access to your saved research data.
faq.q3: How do I get an API Key?
faq.a3: iScholar uses the platform's built-in DeepSeek API by default. If you have your own API Key, you can configure it in Settings.

docs.title: Docs & Resources
docs.subtitle: Get started with iScholar, understand the architecture and best practices
docs.quickStartDesc: Learn iScholar's core concepts and basic workflow in 5 minutes.
quickStartSteps: Set a local password to protect your research data
Run TopicScout to discover candidate topics
Follow the 8-stage workflow through each phase
Export a backup to safely store your research data
docs.userGuideDesc: Detailed user manual covering all 7 agents, citation management, data management, and more.
docs.devGuideDesc: Local development, architecture understanding, and extension guide for developers. Includes directory structure, adding new agents, i18n, and testing.
docs.deployGuideDesc: Vercel one-click deploy, Docker self-hosting, reverse proxy configuration, and data privacy notes.
docs.examplesDesc: Complete input/output examples for all 7 AI agents to help you get started quickly.
docs.architectureDesc: iScholar v6.0 uses a browser-local architecture: Next.js 14 App Router + Dexie.js (IndexedDB) + Transformers.js (local vector embeddings) + DeepSeek API (streaming AI proxy). The server only forwards AI requests — no user data is stored.
